title: Creator Partnerships Manager, Instagram and Meta (Full Time, US Eastern Hours)
description:
HOURS: Monday to Sunday, 9:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern Time (9:00 PM to 5:00 AM Philippine time)



ABOUT US

We're an 8-figure DTC brand that makes baby sling carriers for moms. Most of our growth comes from real mom creators who film themselves using the sling with their babies. We work with hundreds of creators at once on Instagram and Meta, and we're looking for someone to help run that program day to day.



ABOUT THE ROLE

You'll work directly with our creator partnerships lead as part of her team, managing our Instagram and Meta creator program. It's a people role: talking to creators, keeping hundreds of conversations organized, and making sure nobody is ever left waiting for a reply.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Manage our creator Instagram inbox and our Meta Business Suite inbox, replying to creators quickly, warmly and personally (no copy and paste templates)

• Review creators who apply to our program: check the profile is real, that she's a mom with a baby or toddler, that she lives in the US, UK, Canada, Australia, New Zealand or Ireland, and that she talks to camera

• Approve applicants and onboard them into our product seeding program (Social Snowball), where they receive a free sling in exchange for content

• Keep 400 to 500 active creators moving at any given time: follow ups, reminders, check ins after their sling arrives, and keeping them motivated to post

• Find creators who tag us on Instagram, thank them, and ask them to cross post the video to TikTok and YouTube Shorts

• Spot creators whose videos perform well and invite them into our commission program, where they can earn more

• Request Meta partnership ads access from creators and keep those permissions organized

• Create affiliate links for creators and answer their questions about how the program works

• Track every creator and every open conversation in our tracker so nothing slips through

• Send a short daily update and flag anything that needs a decision



WHO WE'RE LOOKING FOR

• Very active and responsive: online and reachable 9 AM to 5 PM EST, Monday to Sunday, replying to messages within minutes, not hours

• Very communicative: you keep us updated without being asked, and you speak up when something is unclear or going wrong

• Available when needed, with some flexibility outside core hours for time sensitive things

• Highly organized: you can juggle 400 to 500 creator conversations without losing track of anyone

• Excellent written English with a warm, friendly, natural tone (you'll be writing to American moms all day)

• Motivated and proactive: you see what needs doing and you do it

• Experience in social media or advertising is preferred. Instagram experience is a must; influencer, UGC or creator management experience is a big plus

• Comfortable with Instagram DMs, Meta Business Suite, Google Sheets and Slack (Social Snowball or Trybe experience is a bonus)

• Full time and exclusive to us. This role needs your full attention, so we're looking for someone who isn't juggling other clients



We can teach you the tools. What we can't teach is great communication, care and reliability, and that's what we hire for.



HOW TO APPLY

1. Start your application with the words "baby sling" so we know you read this post

2. Tell us about any creator, influencer, social media or community management work you've done

3. Send a 1 to 2 minute video introducing yourself (Loom or Google Drive link). Videos only, please don't send voice notes

4. Confirm you can work Monday to Sunday, 9 AM to 5 PM US Eastern Time

5. Confirm you will be working exclusively with us

Type: Part-time to start (~20 hrs/week), with the goal of moving to full-time as we grow

Hours: Flexible to start and subject to change as we grow. Our clients are in the UK, US and Australia, so we need someone who can adapt their hours as the team and client base develop.

This role requires experience. We are not training beginners. If you don’t have real ecommerce
 copy to show us, please don’t apply.



About Us



We’re a small, boutique
 marketing agency working with ecommerce and DTC brands in the UK, US and Australia. Right now we’re a team of three: the founder, a graphic designer, and an

s across multiple client brands. That covers subject lines, preview text, headers, body copy and CTAs. You’ll work from brand guidelines, past campaigns and direction from the founder. What You’ll Be Doing



Writing campaign
s (launches, promos, sales, newsletters) and full flow sequences (welcome, abandoned cart, browse abandonment, post-purchase, winback)

Revising quickly based on founder and client feedback

A portfolio of real ecommerce/DTC
 copy 
s that were actually sent, not samples written for this application)

s convert: offer framing, urgency, objection handling and flow logic

s and CVs sent on their own.

title: Senior Operations Manager
description:
OPA Home Care is a licensed home care agency in Atlanta, Georgia, and part of a small group of healthcare companies I founded and own. Our caregivers serve clients in their homes every day. Our scheduling and coordination team works remotely from the Philippines. I am hiring a senior operations manager to watch that team live through the US day and make sure every piece of work meets the OPA standard.



YOU DO NOT NEED HOME CARE EXPERIENCE

We will teach you home care. We cannot teach you to watch a live board all day and act the minute something breaks. That is what we are hiring.



WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR

- At least two years in a live operations seat where something breaks every shift and you are measured on how fast it gets fixed: BPO real-time analyst or workforce management, US freight or trucking dispatch, network operations center, logistics or airline operations control, emergency dispatch, or ride-hailing or delivery operations.

- At least 18 months with one of your last two employers.

- You already work US hours.



THE JOB

A client waiting for a caregiver cannot see our schedule, and the company cannot watch its own team. Somebody has to watch the work while it is happening, find what is missing, and get it fixed before it reaches a client.

You will:

- Watch open shifts, call-outs, and unconfirmed visits from the start of the US day to the end, and make sure each one has an owner and gets closed.

- Check the schedulers' and coordinators' work against the standard every day, and tell them in writing where it falls short.

- Review recorded calls and
s. Every call and
 at OPA is recorded and transcribed.

- Follow up on every open item, every time, until it is closed. Sending a message does not close an item.

- Close each day with a written report: what is still open, who owns it, and when it will be done.

- Tell me before a deadline when something is going to be late.



THE OPA STANDARD

1. Attention to detail. You catch the shift with no caregiver, the wrong date, and the note that says "covered" when the visit is not covered.

2. Self-starter. You find the problem before anyone assigns it to you.

3. Follow-up. Every item, every time, without fail. If you raised something and nothing happened, you raise it again.

4. Coachability. When you are corrected, your next piece of work shows the correction.

5. Lagniappe. A little bit extra: one more call, one more check, done because the client needed it.



WHO FAILS IN THIS JOB

If "I already messaged them" sounds like a finished task to you, you will fail here. If you would rather not correct someone who has been here longer than you, or you report Monday's problem on Friday, this job will be miserable for you.

Coaching here means telling someone exactly where their work falls short of the standard, showing them what meeting it looks like, and checking the next piece of work, as many times as it takes. It is hard and often harsh.



WHAT YOU NEED

- Excellent written and spoken English.

- Availability for the full US Eastern business day. Some days run longer.

- A reliable computer and internet connection, with a backup for each.



PAY

USD 1,500 per month, paid in two equal halves: the first on the 1st and the second on the 15th. Full-time and long-term. This is the offer. There is no range.



HOW TO APPLY

Read every instruction. Following them is part of the test.

- Use this subject line: Live Ops, your full name, and your current job title.

- Include a link to your resume that opens without requesting access.

- List your last three employers with start and end month and year, and one line on why you left each.

- State the hours you work now, in US Eastern time.

- No cover letter. Answer the four questions below, numbered, in under 700 words total.

- Applications that skip any of the above will not be read.

- We may reply with one follow-up question. Answer it within 24 hours.



QUESTION 1

Below is an end-of-day note a scheduler sent to her manager. OPA rule: a caregiver whose credentialing is not complete may not work after her 30th day.

"Tuesday wrap-up, sent 5:40 p.m. ET. All 38 shifts for Wednesday are confirmed. Two call-outs today, both handled. Maria R. called out of the Johnson visit (8 a.m. to 2 p.m.) and Ana T. covered it. Joseph L. called out of the Patel visit (2 p.m. to 8 p.m.). Still looking, I will update. Ana T. also picks up the Williams visit on Wednesday. Wednesday is her 31st day, and her credentialing paperwork is almost done. Mrs. Williams' daughter called about a visit she says nobody showed up for on Monday. I told her we would look into it."

List every problem in this note. Then write the exact message you would send the scheduler, and say what you would do yourself in the next 30 minutes.



QUESTION 2

Describe your current or last live operations seat in numbers: what you watched, how many items came through per shift, your target response time, and your actual average.



QUESTION 3

Tell us about the worst shift you had in that seat. What broke, what did you do in the first 15 minutes, and how did it end?



QUESTION 4

Describe a time someone senior to you corrected your work. What exactly was wrong, what did you change, and how did your next piece of work show the change?

title: Content Strategist - SEO, Local SEO & AI Search
description:
How to Apply — IMPORTANT: To be considered for this position, you must complete the application form linked at the bottom of this job description. Applications submitted only through Onlinejobs.ph will not be reviewed.

**Please note there are no freelancer positions available within our company.

We ask that you do not continue filling out this form if you are only available as a freelancer or are only available part-time.



About Agency Hero



Agency Hero is a digital marketing company specializing in white-label SEO and WordPress services for agencies. We work behind the scenes as an extension of our agency partners' teams, helping businesses improve organic and local search visibility through SEO strategy, content, technical optimization, Local SEO, and emerging AI search strategies.

We are looking for an experienced Content Strategist to join our SEO team. This role requires strong experience developing content strategies for local and service-area businesses, as well as broader organic SEO campaigns.



This is not primarily a content writing position. We need someone who can analyze websites, local and organic search opportunities, competitors, geographic markets, search intent, and SEO data to determine what content to create or improve, why it should exist, how it should be structured, and how it fits into the overall SEO strategy.



What You'll Do

-As a Content Strategist, you will develop and improve SEO content strategies across client websites, with a significant focus on Local SEO and service-area businesses.

-Develop SEO-driven content strategies for local, service-area, regional, and broader organic campaigns.

Perform keyword research and search-intent analysis, including local and geographic search intent.

-Analyze local SERPs, organic competitors, geographic competitors, and content gaps.

Identify new content opportunities based on services, locations, search demand, competitors, and business priorities.

-Determine when service pages, city/location pages, service-area pages, supporting informational content, and other page types should be created.

-Develop service-to-location content strategies without creating unnecessary, thin, duplicative, or doorway-style pages.

-Audit existing website content and identify pages that should be improved, consolidated, expanded, redirected, or removed.

-Develop topic clusters and supporting content designed to strengthen topical and local authority.

-Map keywords, services, topics, locations, and search intent to appropriate pages.

-Plan website content architecture, including service, location, service-area, and supporting content relationships.

-Develop internal linking strategies that strengthen priority service and location pages.

-Identify and prevent keyword, topic, service, and location cannibalization.

-Create detailed content briefs for writers.

-Analyze competitor websites and SERPs to understand what is required to compete in specific markets.

-Review content for SEO effectiveness, quality, relevance, search intent, local relevance, and publication readiness.

-Consider how website content supports broader local visibility, including Google Business Profile and Map Pack performance.

-Work with other members of our SEO, Local SEO, technical, and content teams.

-Use AI tools to improve research, analysis, strategy development, and workflow efficiency.

-Help develop strategies for traditional Google Search, local search, Google AI experiences, and emerging AI-driven search platforms.



Required Experience

We are looking for candidates with demonstrated professional experience in:



-SEO content strategy.

-Local SEO content strategy for local and service-area businesses.

-Developing service-page and location-page strategies.

-Keyword research and local keyword research.

-Search-intent and geographic-intent analysis.

-Competitor and local competitor research.

-Content-gap analysis.

-Content auditing and optimization.

-Developing content plans and detailed briefs.

-On-page SEO.

-Internal linking.

-Professional content writing and editing experience, with the ability to produce, improve, and evaluate publication-ready SEO content.

This is a full-time employee position, not a freelance or contract role. Local SEO Knowledge

-Local keyword and content cannibalization.

-Internal linking for service and location pages.

-Building topical relevance around priority services and markets.

-The relationship between website content, Google Business Profile, organic local results, and Map Pack visibility.

-Multi-location and multi-market content considerations.



Advanced SEO Skills

Strong candidates should also understand:



-Topical authority and topic clustering.

-Content architecture.

-Keyword, entity, and topic mapping.

-E-E-A-T principles.

-YMYL considerations.

-Search intent.

-Content cannibalization.

-Internal linking strategy.

-Competitor analysis.

-SEO content auditing.

-Content prioritization.

-Google Search Console data.

-Modern search behavior and the evolving relationship between traditional SEO, Local SEO, and AI search.



Experience with tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, and Local SEO/rank-tracking tools is valuable.



AI & Claude Experience

AI is an important part of how our team works. We are particularly interested in candidates who know how to use AI for more than simply generating content.

You should be comfortable using AI to assist with:



-Research and analysis.

-Local and organic content-gap identification.

-Competitor and SERP analysis.

-Content strategy and prioritization.

-Service and location content planning.

-Content briefs.

-SEO analysis.

-Reviewing and improving existing content.

-Identifying entity, topic, and question-coverage opportunities.

-Developing repeatable workflows.

We can teach our specific systems to someone with excellent SEO/content strategy skills who can learn sophisticated AI workflows.



AI Search Visibility

We also want this person to understand how search is evolving beyond traditional organic rankings.



The strategist should be able to consider how content can improve visibility across Google AI experiences and AI-driven platforms such as ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity, and Microsoft Copilot.



This includes thinking about entity clarity, topical coverage, question coverage, authoritative supporting content, and how local businesses and their services, locations, and expertise are represented across the web.



AI search knowledge is important, but it does not replace strong traditional and Local SEO fundamentals.



What We're Looking For

-Thinks strategically rather than simply completing tasks.

title: Video Editor for E-commerce Ads (Fragrance Brand)
description:
We sell affordable alternatives ("dupes") to luxury perfumes: EUR 39.90 versus EUR 245 to 450 for the originals. We need a video editor who thinks like a marketer, someone who studies the product and the customer and then builds short ads that sell.



This is not about pretty footage. A good ad for us has a hook in the first 2 seconds, a clear reason to buy, an offer, and a call to action.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



- Turn our product photos, website assets and existing clips into short ads for Meta and TikTok (9:16 and 1:1).

- Write the hooks and on-screen copy: the dupe angle, the price comparison, proof (reviews, longevity), the offer and the CTA.

- Make several hooks and angles of each ad for testing.

- Add captions, music, pacing and voiceover.

- Take feedback and turn revisions around quickly.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR



- Proven experience editing paid social ads for e-commerce brands. Beauty, fragrance or fashion is a plus.

- You understand direct-response structure: hook, desire, proof, offer, call to action.

- Strong editing with clean, premium-looking typography and captions.

- Real footage and product assets only. No AI-generated visuals.

- Good written English and reliable communication.



TO APPLY, send:



1. Links to 2 or 3 e-commerce ads you edited, and what each ad was trying to sell.

2. One or two sentences: how would you sell a EUR 39.90 perfume dupe to someone who loves a EUR 300 designer scent?

3. Your monthly rate.



Applications that only show AI-generated videos won't be considered.

title: AI Content QA Specialist - Local SEO
description:
How to Apply — IMPORTANT: To be considered for this position, you must complete the application form linked at the bottom of this job description. Applications submitted only through Onlinejobs.ph will not be reviewed.

**Please note there are no freelancer positions available within our company.

We ask that you do not continue filling out this form if you are only available as a freelancer or are only available part-time.



ABOUT AGENCY HERO

Agency Hero is a digital marketing company specializing in white-label SEO and WordPress services for agencies. A significant portion of our work involves helping local and service-area businesses improve their visibility in Google Search and local search results through website content, on-page SEO, local SEO, technical optimization, and AI-assisted workflows.



We are hiring an AI Content QA Specialist with strong Local SEO knowledge to join our SEO team.



This is not primarily a content writing or SEO strategy position. Our Claude Skills and AI-assisted workflows are designed to produce work close to completion. Your responsibility is to run established workflows when assigned, critically review the output, correct appropriate issues, verify that SEO and Local SEO instructions were followed, and help move deliverables to a finished, client-ready standard.



The right person will have strong professional writing and editing skills, understand Local SEO, and know how to evaluate AI-generated content critically. You should be able to distinguish between an actual problem and a stylistic preference, make efficient corrections, and recognize when an issue should be escalated rather than guessed at.



**This is a full-time employee position, not a freelance or contract role. Candidates should have significant professional experience working for or within a digital marketing agency, ideally supporting multiple client accounts and working within established SEO, content, and quality-control processes.



WHAT YOU'LL DO



-Run established Claude Skills and other AI-assisted workflows according to documented processes and instructions.

-Review AI-generated and AI-assisted SEO and Local SEO content before approval or delivery.

-Compare completed work against the original SEO brief, client instructions, business information, target services, target locations, and workflow requirements.

-Review service pages, city/location pages, service-area pages, landing pages, blog content, and other website content used in local SEO campaigns.

-Verify that services, cities, service areas, business details, and other local information are accurate.

-Fact-check statistics, claims, credentials, business information, and other information requiring verification.

-Identify incorrect, unsupported, fabricated, outdated, or contradictory information.

-Make appropriate edits for grammar, clarity, readability, flow, natural wording, and publication quality.

-Remove repetition, filler, awkward phrasing, generic AI language, and content that adds little value.

-Check whether content matches local search intent, page purpose, target audience, service, and geographic market.

-Review keyword usage for relevance, placement, natural integration, geographic relevance, and over-optimization.

-Check page structure, headings, title tags, meta descriptions, internal links, anchor text, and calls to action when included in the brief.

-Review service and location targeting to ensure content is locally relevant rather than simply inserting city names into generic copy.

-Identify thin, duplicated, overly templated, or substantially overlapping service/location content.

-Identify potential keyword, service, topic, or location cannibalization.

-Check internal linking between relevant service, location, and supporting content when required by the brief.

-Identify missed topics, weak sections, or insufficient local relevance.

-Leave clear, actionable QA notes when additional changes are required.

-Recognize when an issue can be corrected independently and when it should be escalated to an SEO strategist or another team member.

-Report recurring AI-output problems that may need to be corrected within the underlying workflow, prompt, or Claude Skill.

-Work efficiently through a consistent volume of AI-assisted deliverables without sacrificing accuracy or review standards.



REQUIRED EXPERIENCE



-Professional content writing and editing experience, with the ability to produce, improve, and evaluate publication-ready SEO content.

-Experience with Local SEO or reviewing content created for local and service-area businesses.

-Reviewing SEO content before publication or client delivery.

-Reviewing service pages, city/location pages, service-area content, landing pages, and blog content.

-Content editing, content quality assurance, or editorial review.

-Fact-checking and source verification.

-Working from detailed SEO or content briefs and following instructions precisely.

-Understanding how services and geographic markets should be represented within website content.

-Editing AI-generated or AI-assisted content.

-Using Claude, ChatGPT, or similar AI tools in a professional workflow.

-Managing multiple pieces of content while maintaining consistent quality standards.

-Strong written English and the editorial judgment to recognize whether content is genuinely publication-ready.



This is a full-time employee position, not a freelance or contract role. Candidates should have significant professional experience working for or within a digital marketing agency, ideally supporting multiple client accounts and working within established SEO, content, and quality-control processes.



LOCAL SEO KNOWLEDGE

Candidates should have working knowledge of:



-Local search intent and geographic keyword targeting.

-Service-page optimization.

-City and location-page optimization.

-Service-area business SEO.

-Local keyword targeting and natural geographic relevance.

-Local content quality and topical relevance.

-On-page SEO for local businesses.

-Heading structure, title tags, and meta descriptions.

-Internal linking between service, location, and supporting pages.

-Thin, duplicated, templated, or substantially overlapping local content.

-Keyword and location over-optimization.

-Basic content cannibalization concepts.

-The difference between genuinely useful location-specific content and generic content with city names inserted into it.

-Basic local SERP and competitor review.

-E-E-A-T and YMYL considerations where applicable.



You do not need to be the person developing the entire Local SEO strategy. However, you must understand Local SEO well enough to recognize when content does not properly execute the strategy or instructions provided.



Experience with tools such as Ahrefs, Semrush, Google Search Console, Screaming Frog, and Local SEO/rank-tracking tools is valuable but not required for every candidate.



AI CONTENT REVIEW

AI is an important part of how our team works. You should understand that AI-generated content can appear polished while still containing significant SEO, Local SEO, factual, or editorial problems.



You should be able to recognize hallucinated or unsupported information, missed instructions, generic or repetitive AI writing, incorrect services or locations, weak geographic relevance, unnatural city/keyword insertion, duplicated local content, and content that sounds good but does not properly satisfy the intended local search intent.



Experience with Claude Projects, Claude Skills, custom GPTs, reusable prompts, or other structured AI workflows is a strong advantage, but it is not required. We care more about your ability to learn structured workflows, follow them precisely, and use AI intelligently.



WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

-Excellent writing and editing ability.

-Excellent attention to detail and strong editorial judgment.

-Strong working knowledge of Local SEO.

-Critical review without unnecessary rewriting based on personal preference.

-A habit of verifying information rather than assuming AI output is correct.

-Ability to recognize incorrect or weak service and location targeting.

-Ability to distinguish factual issues, SEO issues, Local SEO issues, instruction failures, and writing preferences.

-Good judgment about when to edit, approve, flag, return, or escalate work.

-Ability to explain clearly why something needs to be changed.

-Consistent adherence to detailed instructions and SOPs.

-Ability to maintain the same review standard across a high volume of work.

-Discipline to flag unclear or missing information rather than guessing.

-Comfort learning new AI tools, Claude Skills, and evolving workflows.

-An efficient working style that balances quality with appropriate turnaround time.



POSITION DETAILS

Position: AI Content QA Specialist - Local SEO

Schedule: Full-Time

Hours: 8:00 AM-4:00 PM Eastern Time

Location: Remote - Worldwide

Compensation: PHP 75,000-PHP 108,000, based on experience and demonstrated skill level.



Candidates must be able to consistently work the required Eastern Time schedule.



APPLICATION PROCESS

Applications submitted through the job platform alone will not be considered. To apply, candidates must complete our application form:



The application includes questions about Local SEO, content writing/editing, QA, and AI experience and requires a short video introduction.



Candidates who successfully complete the initial review may be invited to complete a practical AI Content QA assessment based on the actual responsibilities of the position.



For the assessment, candidates will review an AI-generated Local SEO content draft together with the original SEO instructions, target service/location information, and supporting business information. The task will require the candidate to identify factual, editorial, SEO, and Local SEO issues, make appropriate edits, flag anything requiring a larger revision or escalation, and provide clear QA notes.



The goal is not to see how much you can rewrite. We want to determine whether you can take AI-assisted Local SEO content that is already close to completion and reliably handle the final quality-control process needed to make it publication-ready.



HIRING PROCESS

Application + Video → Initial Review → Practical AI Content QA Assessment → Team Review → Interview → Final Evaluation



Please do not apply unless you are willing to complete the full application process and can consistently work 8:00 AM-4:00 PM Eastern Time.

title: Cleaning Company VA – Phone Sales, Customer Service + Dispatch (US Residential Cleaning Experience Required)
description:
HOURS: Monday to Friday, 9 AM – 6 PM US Eastern (9 PM – 6 AM Philippine time; 10 PM – 7 AM from Nov 1).



PAY: $700/month, raise after a 60-day review. Paid monthly through OnlineJobs.ph Easypay. Long-term, full-time, working directly with the owners.



⚠️ READ THIS FIRST

This job is only for people who have already worked as a VA for a US (or Canada/UK/Australia) residential cleaning company: house cleaning, maid service, move-out cleans. If you've never worked for a cleaning company, please don't apply. We'll skip it, even if you're great at everything else.



ABOUT US

We're two 19-year-old college students running Vassal Cleaning, a house cleaning company in Miami and South Florida. We book cleans for nice homes and send independent cleaners to do them. Small team, no corporate stuff.



WHAT YOU'LL DO

Sales (most of the job)

- Text every new lead back in under 1 minute, then call them. Leads come from Thumbtack, Google and our website.

- Quote from our price list (standard, deep, move-in/move-out, add-ons like inside the fridge and oven) and close the booking.

- Handle "that's more than I expected" and follow up with everyone who didn't book.



Customer service

- Reschedules, add-ons, and complaints. A missed spot means booking a reclean, not arguing.

- Keep every client's notes right: gate codes, parking, pets, what they care about.



Dispatch

- Match each booked clean with a cleaner, confirm them the day before and the morning of.

- When a cleaner cancels at 7 AM for a 9 AM job, find a replacement fast and tell the client before they notice.



MUST HAVE

- 1+ year as a VA, CSR, booker or dispatcher for a residential cleaning company. Tell us which company type and roughly how many cleaners and jobs a week you handled.

- Excellent spoken and written English, with a clear, neutral accent. Our clients are in Miami and should feel like they called someone local. We judge this from your voice message.

- You've quoted cleaning jobs by bedrooms/bathrooms or square feet, and you know the difference between a standard, deep and move-out clean.

- At your computer the whole shift, replying in under 1 minute. Reliable internet plus a backup, a quiet spot and a headset.



BIG PLUS

- You've used cleaning software: Booking Koala, ZenMaid, Launch27, Jobber, Housecall Pro or MaidCentral

- Thumbtack, Angi, Yelp or Google Local Services leads

- Quo/OpenPhone or another texting/calling app

- You know who TJR is and keep up with US pop culture



HOW TO APPLY

We read every application ourselves. If it reads like ChatGPT wrote it, we skip it. Write like you'd text a friend; typos are fine. Skip a step and we won't read the rest.



1. Subject line: "Vassal Cleaning VA – [your name]"

2. Your cleaning experience in 3–4 sentences: what company type and where, how long, how many cleaners and jobs a week, and what software you used.

3. A 60–90 second voice message (Vocaroo, Google Drive or Loom). A lead calls: "How much for a deep clean, 3 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms, about 1,800 sq ft?" Give a price (make one up), then they say "hmm, that's more than I expected." Show us what you say next.

4. In 1–2 sentences: a client texts that the cleaner missed the baseboards and the shower glass. What do you text back?

5. In 1–2 sentences: a cleaner texts at 7 AM that she can't make her 9 AM job. What do you do first?

6. Who is TJR? One sentence, no Googling. Wrong answers are fine.

7. Confirm you can work 9 AM – 6 PM US Eastern, Monday to Friday.



Shortlisted applicants get a short paid test.

title: Acquisition Training & Performance Coach
description:
PLEASE APPLY THROUGH THIS LINK: 
/apply-job-1



About us:



With over 100 years of combined industry experience, the Community Minerals team specializes in the purchase of mineral or royalty rights all over the US. We have earned a stellar reputation with hundreds of satisfied customers and an “A” Rating with the Better Business Bureau. With our proven track record, we continue to serve mineral owners in several states with transparency, accountability, and a personalized experience to meet individual needs.



Job Summary:



The Acquisition Training & Performance Coach is responsible for providing dedicated training, coaching, and performance support to the Acquisition Department. This role focuses on developing role-specific knowledge, skills, processes, and behaviors required for successful performance across Acquisition functions. The role is responsible for delivering Acquisition-specific training, facilitating onboarding and refresher sessions, identifying capability gaps, and providing ongoing coaching to improve contractor performance, quality, productivity, and adherence to established processes and standards.



What You’ll Do:



Training Program Design & Development:

• Design and develop engaging training programs, modules, and materials aligned with Acquisition operational goals and requirements.

• Apply instructional design principles and adult learning methodologies.

• Customize learning solutions based on Acquisition business needs, role requirements, and competency gaps.

• Develop practical learning activities, assessments, and knowledge checks to reinforce understanding and application.

• Update training materials and resources when Acquisition processes, systems, tools, or SOPs change.

• Identify recurring knowledge gaps and develop appropriate training interventions.



Training Delivery & Facilitation:

• Facilitate instructor-led and virtual training sessions for contractors within the Acquisition Department.

• Ensure high-quality delivery and participant engagement.

• Coach and support facilitators/trainers as needed.

• Conduct onboarding, process training, refresher training, and upskilling sessions specific to Acquisition functions.

• Provide additional training or remediation to contractors who require further support.

• Support newly trained contractors during their transition into production.



Performance Coaching:

• Provide individual and group coaching to Acquisition contractors to support continuous performance improvement.

• Review performance results, quality findings, productivity data, and other relevant metrics to identify coaching opportunities.

• Provide timely, constructive, and actionable feedback to contractors.

• Develop coaching or performance improvement plans for contractors who require additional support.

• Monitor progress following coaching interventions and provide follow-up coaching as needed.

• Reinforce correct processes, behaviors, and best practices through continuous coaching.

• Recognize strong performance and encourage continuous development among high-performing contractors.

• Partner with Acquisition Team Leads to support performance improvement while maintaining clear accountability within the operational leadership structure.



Training Needs Analysis & Capability Assessment:

• Conduct training needs assessments within the Acquisition Department.

• Collaborate with Acquisition Team Leads to identify recurring performance issues that may be addressed through training or coaching.

• Analyze performance trends to determine whether gaps are related to knowledge, skills, process understanding, or execution.

• Recommend appropriate training and coaching interventions based on identified needs.

• Identify opportunities to strengthen role readiness, competency, and overall team capability.



Program Evaluation & Continuous Improvement:

• Measure training effectiveness through feedback, assessments, and performance metrics.

• Continuously improve programs based on evaluation results.

• Evaluate whether training and coaching interventions result in improvements in quality, productivity, accuracy, and process adherence.

• Identify recurring performance trends and recommend improvements to training content, coaching strategies, or operational processes.

• Work with Acquisition leadership to address recurring knowledge, skill, and performance gaps.

• Recommend improvements to onboarding, training, coaching, and knowledge reinforcement processes.



Stakeholder Collaboration:

• Partner with the Acquisition Operations Team Lead and Acquisition Team Leads to align learning initiatives with Acquisition operational priorities and performance goals.

• Provide recommendations to Acquisition leadership regarding capability gaps and performance development opportunities.

• Collaborate with Acquisition stakeholders to support process changes, new initiatives, and operational improvements requiring training or coaching.

• Support Acquisition initiatives that require training, coaching, or capability development.



Learning Administration & Reporting:

• Track training attendance, completion, and effectiveness.

• Maintain accurate training records and generate reports.

• Track coaching activities, performance improvement interventions, and competency outcomes.

• Prepare reports on training participation, competency results, coaching activities, and performance trends.

• Maintain accurate and up-to-date Acquisition training materials and documentation.

• Provide management with insights and recommendations based on training and coaching data.



What We’re Looking For:



Education:

• Bachelor’s degree in Human Resources, Psychology, Education, or related field.



Experience:

• At least 3–4 years of experience in Learning and Development, Training, Coaching, Operations Training, or a related field.

• Approximately 3–4 years of relevant Sales experience, preferably with BPO or outbound Sales experience. Relevant Sales experience and demonstrated capability are highly preferred given the operational requirements of the role.



Technical Skills:

• Strong knowledge of instructional design models

• Experience in creating learning modules, facilitator guides, and e-learning content

• Proficiency in Learning Management Systems (LMS) and digital learning platforms

• Skilled in Microsoft Office tools, particularly PowerPoint, Excel, and Word

• Ability to analyze training metrics, completion rates, and effectiveness reports

• Familiarity with survey and assessment tools for learning evaluation.

• Strong understanding of Sales processes and customer engagement, with the ability to evaluate performance and identify areas for improvement.

• Ability to audit and review customer calls and assess areas such as confidence, engagement, probing, active listening, and adherence to established processes and standards.



Soft Skills:

• Excellent communication and presentation skills

• Strong facilitation and audience engagement capability

• Stakeholder management and business partnering skills

• Strong problem-solving and critical-thinking ability

• Effective time management and project coordination skills

• Adaptability in handling diverse learners and changing priorities

• Ability to provide clear, constructive, and actionable feedback through performance coaching.



Industry Knowledge:

• Foundational knowledge of upstream oil and gas operations, production, and well lifecycle.

• Understanding of marketed deal structures and acquisition processes is a plus.



Competencies and Attributes:

• Thrives in a fast-paced, remote-first work environment.

• Demonstrates discipline, focus, and reliability in support tasks.

• Aligns with the team’s emphasis on operational excellence, compliance, and support for technical evaluation.

• Open to collaboration, feedback, and process alignment across teams.



What's in it for You:

• Competitive Compensation: Earn $4.19-$4.72 per hour paid in foreign currency, commensurate with your skills and experience.

• Work your way: Remote Work Set-Up enabling you to operate from the comfort and convenience of your own chosen workspace

• Success Incentives: Enjoy company bonuses and performance-driven rewards.

• Soar with Us: Opportunities for career growth and promotions await you.

• Positive Vibes Only: Experience a supportive and uplifting work culture.

• Annual Bonus: We value your dedication throughout the year, rewarding you with annual performance bonus shared at the end of the year.

• Performance Raise: Your hard work doesn't go unnoticed. Be ready to seize opportunities for salary increase based on your outstanding performance.

• Performance Incentives: We believe exceptional work deserves recognition. Performance incentives are awarded to individuals who demonstrate outstanding contributions, initiative, and results. It’s our way of celebrating excellence and motivating continued success.

• Discretionary Bonus: At Community Minerals, exceptional work doesn’t go unnoticed. Contractors who consistently go above and beyond may be rewarded with discretionary bonuses, a token of appreciation for outstanding contributions, impactful results, and dedication to excellence. Let your work speak, and the rewards will follow!



Other Requirements

• Willing to work in US Business Hours (CST)

• Must have stable Internet and Power Connection



System Requirements

• To ensure optimal performance and functionality while using different web and application tools, please make sure that your system meets the following requirements:



Operating System:

• Windows: Windows 10 (64-bit) or higher

• macOS: macOS 11 (Big Sur) or higher



Processor:

• Intel: 8th Gen Core i3, i5, i7, or newer

• AMD: Ryzen 3 (2018) or newer



Memory (RAM):

• A minimum of 8 GB of RAM is required.



• Recommended: 16 GB RAM for multitasking and optimal performance.

title: Financial Representative (CPA) – Property Management
description:
Position Overview



We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Certified Public Accountant (CPA) to join our growing property management company as a Financial Representative. This position is responsible for overseeing the financial operations of a diverse real estate portfolio, ensuring accurate financial reporting, maintaining compliance, and providing strategic financial guidance to leadership. The ideal candidate is analytical, organized, and experienced in managing multiple entities within a fast-paced property management environment.



Key Responsibilities



- Manage full-cycle accounting for multiple properties and related entities, including accounts payable, accounts receivable, general ledger, and month-end close.

- Prepare and analyze monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements.

- Ensure compliance with GAAP, tax regulations, lender requirements, and company policies.

- Oversee cash flow management, budgeting, forecasting, and financial planning.

- Reconcile bank accounts, credit cards, and balance sheet accounts.

- Review and maintain the accuracy of all financial transactions and accounting records.

- Prepare management reports and financial analyses for ownership and executive leadership.

- Collaborate with property managers to analyze property performance and identify opportunities to improve financial results.

- Coordinate with external auditors, tax professionals, and financial institutions.

- Assist with annual budgets, CAM reconciliations, owner distributions, and financial reporting.

- Develop, implement, and improve accounting policies, procedures, and internal controls.

- Ensure all financial deadlines are met while maintaining the highest level of accuracy and confidentiality.

- Provide guidance and support to accounting staff and assist with special financial projects as assigned.



Qualifications



- Active CPA license required.

- Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred).

- Minimum of five years of accounting experience, preferably in property management, real estate, or multi-entity accounting.

- Strong knowledge of GAAP, financial reporting, budgeting, and internal controls.

- Experience with property management and accounting software preferred (Yardi, RealPage, QuickBooks, or similar).

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and financial analysis.

- Excellent analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.

- Strong written and verbal communication skills.

- Ability to manage multiple priorities and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.

- Professional, ethical, and committed to maintaining strict confidentiality.

Paid time off and company holidays.

title: You Tube Video Editor
description:
Team Rajpal, a Greater Toronto Area real estate team, in Pickering specifically is hiring a freelance video editor to produce at least one long-form YouTube video per week. Each video runs 15 to 30 minutes and is either a house tour, a market update or a community update.

This is a remote, ongoing contract. We want one reliable editor who learns our style and becomes part of our weekly content routine.

Scope of work

You will edit one finished video per week, rotating through three formats.

Format

-House Tour- Walkthrough of a listing

-Market Update- Agent/s on camera in front of a green screen explaining market trends- using supporting information

- Community Update- Tour of the community with specific area updates 



Each week you will also deliver a custom thumbnail and, if requested, one or two short vertical clips cut from the main video for YouTube Shorts and Instagram Reels.



Style references

Please study these two channels before applying. We want our videos to match their pacing and polish.

• Market updates: Tom Storey (YouTube). Clear, data-driven talking-head videos. Tight cuts with no dead air, clean charts and stats on screen, and a strong hook in the first 30 seconds.

• House tours: Mark Salerno (Salerno Realty). Smooth, cinematic walkthroughs with steady pacing, colour grading, music that suits the home, and clean text for key features.



Community updates should blend the two: Tom Storey's clarity with Mark Salerno's visual quality.



Responsibilities

Editing

• Cut raw footage into a tight, engaging 15–30 minute video, removing pauses, mistakes and filler.

• Add b-roll, drone footage, music, sound design and colour correction.

• Build on-screen graphics: charts and stats for market updates, and address, price and feature callouts for house tours.

• Add Team Rajpal branding, including logo, intro, outro and contact details.

• Add accurate English captions.



YouTube channel support (when needed)

• Upload videos to our channel with titles, descriptions, tags and chapters.

• Upload thumbnails, add end screens and cards, and organise playlists by format.

• Schedule videos to publish at our set weekly time.

• Keep the channel tidy and consistent, and flag anything that needs our attention.



Requirements

Must have

• Excellent written and spoken English. You must catch errors in captions and on-screen text without being told.

• A portfolio of long-form YouTube videos (15+ minutes), ideally including real estate or talking-head content.

• Experience editing for the Canadian market, or the attention to detail to learn our standards (see below).

• Able to deliver within 24 hours of receiving footage.

• Experience uploading to and managing a YouTube channel, including titles, descriptions, thumbnails, playlists and scheduling.

• Professional editing software, such as Adobe Premiere Pro, Final Cut Pro or DaVinci Resolve.

• Reliable, responsive communication during Toronto business hours (Eastern Time).



Nice to have/BONUS

• Experience editing real estate content for Canadian agents.

• Motion graphics skills in After Effects or similar.

• YouTube SEO and thumbnail design skills.



Editing for the Canadian market

Our audience is Canadian buyers and sellers, so every video must look and sound Canadian, not American. Use this table as your checklist.



If you are unsure whether something is Canadian, ask before publishing.

Turnaround and weekly workflow

We aim for a first cut within 24 hours of sending footage, and a final version within 24 hours of our feedback.

1. Team Rajpal shares raw footage, notes and any listing or market data through Google Drive.

2. You deliver the first cut and a draft thumbnail within 24 hours.

3. We send one round of consolidated feedback.

4. You deliver the final video, thumbnail and any short clips within 24 hours.

5. If YouTube support is part of your role, you upload and schedule the video.

Tell us in advance about any days you are unavailable, so we can plan around them.

How to apply

Please send:

• Links to 2–3 long-form YouTube videos you edited, ideally real estate or talking-head content.

• Your rate per finished 15–30 minute video, and any monthly rate for four videos.

• Confirmation that you can meet a 24-hour turnaround, and your working hours in Eastern Time.

• A short note on your experience managing YouTube channels.

• One sentence on how editing for a Canadian audience differs from a US audience.

Shortlisted applicants may be asked to complete one paid test edit.

title: News Writing Assistant
description:
News Writing Assistant



Remote | Philippines | Paid trial



Pay: $600 a month



Hours: Monday to Friday, 7am to 3pm UK time (3pm to 11pm Philippine time).



Start: early to mid-November 2026



About us



We’re a UK news agency. We supply stories, photos and video to major news websites.



We need a careful writer for one task: turning a story our editors have chosen into a short news draft, using our template and AI tools.



For every story:



What we give you



1. The story, chosen by our news team

2. The source links, pictures and video

3. Our template, style guide and example stories

4. The AI and translation tools you need



What you do



1. Read everything in the package. Translate it with our tools where needed.

2. Write a short article draft in our template, with help from AI.

3. Check the draft against our accuracy checklist:

   1. Every name, date, place, number and quote matches the sources.

   2. The headline and story should only describe what the pictures or video actually show.

   3. For live stories, such as disasters or accidents, a quick search shows if numbers like the death toll have changed. Update the number and add a link to the new source so the editor can verify it.

4. Send the draft to the editor and list anything you’re unsure about.

5. An editor reviews every draft before it goes out and will ask questions if they arise.



Important: If sources disagree or something can’t be checked, never guess. Always flag it to an editor.



The day



1. 7 to 11am UK is the busiest time. Deadlines are tight and articles need to be written and checked quickly.

2. After 11am, you’ll help the team and learn new tasks.

3. Once you’re fully trained, the aim is to write five drafts a day.



What we’re looking for



1. Excellent written English

2. Careful reading. You notice when something doesn’t add up.

3. You ask when you’re not sure.

4. Quick, reliable replies on Slack



You don’t need to be a journalist. Writing, editing or research experience helps. You’ll show us your skills in the paid assessment.



You’ll need



1. Your own laptop

2. A reliable internet connection



If a storm, power cut or connection problem stops you working, tell your editor as soon as you can.



Sensitive material



Stories often involve crime, violence, accidents and deaths. Some pictures and video may be distressing. Only apply if you’re comfortable with this.



How to apply



1. Subject line: News Writing Assistant – [Your Full Name]

title: Virtual Interview & Candidate Engagement Specialist
description:
Virtual Interview & Candidate Engagement Specialist | $8/hour | Part-Time



20 Hours per Week | Starting at $8 USD/Hour | US Business Hours | Remote



We’re looking for an exceptionally confident, articulate and engaging communicator to join our growing recruitment team!



We provide recruitment services to direct sales companies across the United States, helping them identify, engage and recruit candidates for entry-level sales opportunities.



We’re introducing a new position focused on conducting one-on-one preliminary Zoom interviews with potential candidates.



This isn’t your typical recruitment or virtual assistant role.



These interviews are more than traditional screening conversations. They’re an opportunity to build rapport, identify potential, communicate the value of an opportunity and leave candidates genuinely excited about taking the next step.







What You’ll Be Doing



* Conduct engaging 10–15-minute, one-on-one preliminary video Zoom interviews with US-based candidates.

* Speak with candidates who have applied directly for entry-level sales positions, as well as candidates identified through Smart Match who may not have applied for the specific opportunity.

* Build rapport quickly, establish interest and create an excellent first impression.

* Confidently introduce our clients’ businesses, their opportunities and potential career progression.

* Present entry-level sales opportunities in an enthusiastic, compelling and accurate way.

* Naturally address candidate questions, concerns and objections without relying on scripted responses.

* Assess candidate suitability, motivation, availability and interest.

* Encourage suitable, interested candidates to progress to the next stage of the recruitment process.

* Maintain accurate interview notes and communicate effectively with our recruitment team.







Who We’re Looking For



We’re particularly interested in someone who is:



* An exceptional communicator: Your spoken English is fluent, natural and effortless, and you’re comfortable communicating with American candidates.

* Confident and charismatic: You have a warm, engaging personality and can make people feel comfortable while confidently leading the conversation.

* Naturally persuasive: You understand how to communicate value, generate excitement and address objections without sounding scripted or overly sales-driven.

* Quick-thinking and adaptable: You can respond intelligently to unexpected questions, read the conversation and adjust your approach.

* An excellent listener: You can identify what matters to a candidate and tailor your conversation accordingly.

* Highly professional on camera: You have a polished, confident presence and understand the importance of representing our clients professionally.

* Reliable and independent: You’re organised, punctual and comfortable managing scheduled interviews with minimal supervision.



Experience in sales, recruitment, admissions, business development or other communication-focused roles is highly desirable.



However, outstanding communication skills, confidence and personality matter more to us than a particular professional background.







Your Home Office Setup



As you’ll be representing US-based businesses in live Zoom interviews, your professional presentation is extremely important.



You’ll need:



* A high-quality webcam providing clear, professional video.

* Excellent lighting and a clean, professional background.

* A quality microphone or headset with clear audio.

* A reliable computer and stable, high-speed internet.

* A quiet, private workspace free from interruptions.





What We Offer



* Starting compensation of $8 USD per hour.

* An initial part-time schedule of approximately 20 hours per week.

* Consistent work aligned with US business hours.

* Training, support and an established recruitment process.

* Opportunities for increased hours, responsibility and compensation as the role develops.





How to Apply



We want to see your personality and communication skills in action!



Please submit your CV along with a 60–90-second video introduction, recorded in the workspace you would use for this position.



In your video, please:



1. Introduce yourself and briefly describe your relevant experience.

2. Explain what makes you an exceptional communicator.

3. Tell us how you would approach a conversation with a candidate who is unsure whether an entry-level sales opportunity is right for them.



Important: Your video introduction must be recorded specifically for this position and address the three points above. Generic, previously recorded video introductions will not be considered.



There’s no need for elaborate editing or production. We’re looking for natural confidence, excellent communication, a professional on-camera presence and the ability to think independently.



Applications without a role-specific video introduction will not be considered.

title: LEAD Video Editor | DTC + AI | Up to $1,800 + Performance Bonuses
description:
THIS IS NOT A NORMAL VIDEO EDITOR ROLE!



We’re looking for an exceptional Lead Video Editor to take ownership of our editing team and creative execution for a fast-growing DTC brand.



First and foremost, you need to be extremely strong at editing and AI generation yourself.



We are looking for someone who is genuinely elite at the craft, understands what makes a direct response ad perform, and can spot the small details that separate an average edit from an excellent one.



On top of that, you must have previous experience leading editors, supervising creative output, building systems and training people.



This is not an entry-level management role.



WHAT WE’RE LOOKING FOR



\- Exceptional video editing skills  

\- Advanced AI image and video generation skills  

\- Previous experience leading and managing a team of video editors  

\- Experience building editing workflows, systems and quality-control processes  

\- Ability to train, teach and improve other editors  

\- Strong DTC / e-commerce experience  

\- Good understanding of direct response advertising  

\- Strong understanding of retention and viewer psychology  

\- Excellent sense of pacing, hooks and storytelling  

\- Extremely strong attention to detail  

\- Highly reliable, organised and communicative  

\- Ability to take ownership without needing constant supervision



YOUR ROLE



You will be responsible for managing and supervising a team of up to 5 video editors.



Your job is to make sure every creative leaving the editing team is produced to the highest possible standard.



This includes:



\- Reviewing editors’ work before final delivery  

\- Making sure every video follows the creative brief exactly  

\- Checking pacing, cuts, transitions, sound design and storytelling  

\- Making sure hooks are executed as strongly as possible  

\- Reviewing AI-generated clips and making sure the generation quality is excellent  

\- Catching small visual, logical or continuity mistakes others may miss  

\- Giving clear and actionable feedback to editors  

\- Training editors and helping them continuously improve  

\- Building systems and processes that improve quality and efficiency  

\- Making sure deadlines and output targets are consistently met  

\- Taking responsibility for the overall quality of the editing team



You should be the type of person who notices when a cut is slightly too slow, an AI generation feels unnatural, a visual does not match the script properly, or a scene could be improved to hold attention longer.



We care a lot about these small details.



AI EXPERIENCE IS CRITICAL



AI generation is a major part of our creative workflow.



You should be highly experienced with tools such as:



\- Kling  

\- OmniFlash  

\- HeyGen  

\- Seedance  

\- Nano Banana Pro  

\- Higgsfield  

\- ElevenLabs  

\- Other leading AI image, video and voice-generation tools



You should also stay completely up to date with new AI models, tools and workflows and understand which tools produce the best results for different types of scenes.



We don’t want someone who occasionally experiments with AI. You should be extremely comfortable generating, iterating and troubleshooting AI creative at a high level.



LEADERSHIP



Being a great editor yourself is only one part of this role.



You also need to know how to get great work out of other editors.



You should be able to:



\- Explain clearly why something is wrong and how to improve it  

\- Train editors in both editing and AI generation  

\- Establish clear quality standards  

\- Give detailed but efficient feedback  

\- Identify weaknesses in individual editors and help them improve  

\- Hold the team accountable for quality and deadlines  

\- Create systems that allow the team to produce consistently strong work



We’re looking for someone who takes responsibility for the team rather than simply reviewing videos and passing feedback along.



COMPENSATION



\- Up to $1,800/month flat compensation depending on experience and ability  

\- Additional performance-based bonuses  

\- Bonuses can potentially add $1,000+ per month depending on your performance and the performance of the editing team  

\- Long-term opportunity with increasing responsibility as the brand grows



Strong performance will be rewarded.



HOW TO APPLY



Please send us a short application written by you personally.



Do not send a generic or AI-generated application.



Please include:



1. Why you believe you are a strong fit for this Lead Editor role

2. Your previous experience leading or managing a team of editors

3. How many editors you have managed before and what your responsibilities were

4. Your experience with DTC / e-commerce and direct response advertising

5. Your experience with AI generation and which tools you use regularly

6. 3-5 recent videos that you personally edited and are most proud of



IMPORTANT: Please do not send your entire portfolio.



We only want to see 3-5 strong, recent examples that you personally edited and that accurately represent your current level.



We are looking for someone who is extremely strong technically, obsessed with quality, reliable, capable of leading others and ready to take full ownership of the editing team.

title: Amazon & Marketplace Operations Manager – Client Facing
description:
Amazon & Marketplace Campaign Manager – Client Facing

Full-Time | Remote | 40 Hours per Week | UK Business Hours



About the Role:

We are an established eCommerce marketplace agency working with a portfolio of UK and international brands across Amazon and other major online marketplaces.

We are looking for an experienced Amazon & Marketplace Campaign Manager who can take ownership of client accounts and act as the link between the client and our internal marketplace, advertising, content and operations teams.

This is not a basic VA or task-based position.

We need someone who is confident speaking directly with clients, understands how marketplace accounts operate commercially and operationally, can identify problems before the client does, and can make sure work gets completed correctly and on time.



You will manage several client accounts and will be expected to understand what is happening across each account, what the priorities are, what the client is expecting and what the internal team needs to deliver.



What You Will Do

- Own the day-to-day management of a portfolio of eCommerce clients.

- Be a primary point of contact for clients through meetings,
 and Slack.

- Run regular client calls and confidently discuss performance, problems, priorities and next steps.

- Create clear actions following client meetings and make sure they are completed by the appropriate internal team members.

- Manage Amazon Seller Central and/or Vendor Central activity across client accounts.

- Coordinate listing creation, catalogue management, variation structures, content optimisation, A+, Brand Stores and marketplace launches.

- Monitor listing suppressions, account health, inventory issues, pricing problems and other marketplace errors.

- Review sales and performance data and identify issues or opportunities rather than simply sending reports.

- Work across Amazon UK/EU and, depending on the client, marketplaces such as eBay, Tesco, B&Q, Debenhams and others.

- Maintain accurate client plans, priorities, deadlines and project trackers.

- Follow up with internal specialists and ensure agreed client work is delivered.

- Escalate problems early rather than waiting for clients to raise them.

- Look for opportunities to improve client accounts and grow marketplace revenue.



What We Are Looking For

- You should already have strong Amazon/eCommerce marketplace experience. This is not an entry-level role.



Ideally you will have:

- 3+ years of Amazon or marketplace account-management experience.

- Previous experience working for an Amazon/eCommerce agency or managing multiple brands/accounts simultaneously.

- Strong hands-on knowledge of Amazon Seller Central. Vendor Central experience is a major advantage.

- Excellent spoken and written English.

- Experience communicating directly with UK, US, Australian or other international clients.

- Confidence leading Zoom/Teams client meetings without needing a senior manager to take over.

- Strong understanding of catalogue management, listings, variations, account health, inventory and Amazon operational issues.

- Good understanding of Amazon SEO, titles, bullet points, backend search terms, A+ Content and Brand Stores.

- Working knowledge of Amazon advertising and the ability to understand and challenge PPC performance.

- Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills and confidence interpreting marketplace data.

- Excellent organisation and project-management skills.

- Ability to manage multiple clients, deadlines and internal team members simultaneously.

- Strong attention to detail and a habit of checking work before it reaches the client.

- A proactive mindset — we want someone who comes to us with solutions, not just problems.

- Experience with tools or platforms such as Linnworks, ChannelEngine, Rithum, Shopify, eBay, Helium 10, or similar marketplace technology would be advantageous.



The Type of Person Who Will Succeed:

We are looking for someone who can genuinely own an account.

If a client asks why sales dropped, you should be comfortable investigating the data and forming a sensible explanation.

If listings are suppressed, inventory has disappeared, content has not gone live or a project is late, you should be finding out why and driving the resolution.

If an internal team member misses a deadline, you follow it up.

If you see an opportunity that the client has not asked about, you raise it.

You should be comfortable working independently while being part of a wider team of marketplace, PPC, content, creative and technical specialists.



Working Hours:

This is a full-time remote position, 40 hours per week.

You must be comfortable working hours that provide strong overlap with UK business hours, as you will regularly attend client and internal meetings.



Reliable internet, a professional home-working environment and the ability to join client calls with camera and microphone are required.



How to Apply



Please send us:

- Your CV/resume.

- Your expected monthly salary in USD.

- How many years of Amazon Seller Central/Vendor Central experience you have.

- How many client accounts or brands you have managed simultaneously.

- Which marketplaces and eCommerce tools you have worked with.

- A short example of a difficult Amazon/client problem that you personally took ownership of and resolved.

- A 60–90 second video or voice introduction explaining your current role and why you believe you are suitable for a client-facing account-management position.



Please start your application with the words “Marketplace Manager” so we know you have read the full job description.



We are looking for a long-term team member who wants to take ownership, work directly with established eCommerce brands and grow into a senior position within the business.

title: Appointment Setter
description:
DM Appointment Setter: Full-Time, Remote



 $500–$1,000/month base + uncapped commission



---



## Read this first



We're not looking for "a VA who does some DMs."



We're looking for one person who treats this like a real office job. You sit down, close the distractions, and work the inbox for 8 hours. Every day.



If you've set before and burned out after a week of blasting messages, this isn't for you.



If you do what you say you'll do, follow up with every lead and care about the small details, keep reading.



---



## Who we are



7 Figure Scaling Systems (7FSS) helps online coaches scale their businesses. We have a full sales team, paid ads running every day, and inbound leads coming into our Instagram inboxes.



**The leads are already there. We need someone to work them properly.**



You won't be cold DMing strangers from nothing. Our AI inbox tool (LeadWizard) writes the first messages and does part of the qualifying. Your job is to keep every conversation moving until it turns into a booked call.



---



## What you'll actually do



- **Work the DM inbox for a full shift.** Reply to every lead. Don't leave conversations hanging.

- **Run follow-ups 1, 2 and 3 every day, including weekends.

** Most calls get lost because someone stopped following up. You won't let that happen.

- **Use our AI tool properly.** It suggests the replies. You check them, send them and move each lead to the right stage. No copy-paste "yo bro" messages.

- **Qualify before you book.** We want coaches who have the money and the intent to invest, not anyone who says yes to a call.

- **Book calls into our closers' calendars** and hand each one over with clear notes.

- **Dial leads (for the $1,000 base).

** If you can call leads as well as message them, you're worth more to us and we pay you more.

- **Show up.** Join the daily team call. Post your numbers in Slack. Report your work every day.



---



## What success looks like



- Every lead in the inbox gets answered, on time, every day.

- Every follow-up stage is cleared. Nobody sits in "Follow Up 2" for three days.

- Qualified calls go on the calendar every week, and those calls show up.

- Your manager never has to wonder what you did today. It's in Slack.



---



## What we pay



**Base (monthly, USD)** **Plus**

| **DM setting only** | $500 | Uncapped commission |

| **DM setting + dialing** | $1,000 | Uncapped commission |



The base pays for the work you show up and do. The commission is what you earn from results. There's no cap, so the more qualified calls you book, the more you take home.



---



You're a fit if



- You've worked as an appointment setter, in DM sales or in customer-facing chat before. Coaching or high-ticket experience is a bonus.

- You write clear, natural English. It shouldn't read like a script, and it shouldn't read like AI.

- You're organised. You'd rather do the work properly than look busy.

- You can commit to a fixed full-time schedule with a strong internet connection and a quiet place to work.

- You take feedback well and fix things the same day.



You're NOT a fit if



- You work in bursts, sending lots of volume and then disappearing for a few days.

- You need to be chased to join team calls or post in Slack.

- You plan to pass the account to someone else to run. We will find out.

- You're juggling three other clients and want this as a side gig.



---



Why work with us



- **Leads are already coming in.** You don't have to create demand. You just need to work it.

- **AI tools do the heavy lifting**, so your time goes on conversations that can turn into calls.

- **You learn high-ticket sales from a team that does it every day.** Our closers and managers train with you.

- **Long-term role.** We want someone to grow with us, not someone we replace in a month.



---

How to apply (follow every step or we won't review your application)



1. **Watch the full video here:** 
/hiring-setter

2. **Click "Apply Now"** on that page and complete the application.

3. **Reply to this ad with a 2-minute Loom video** covering:

    - Who you are, and your setting or sales experience

    - Your best result (calls booked per week, show rate, anything with numbers)

    - Why you'd treat this like a real job

4. **Start your message with the words "I WORKED THE INBOX".** That's how we know you read the whole ad.



We review every application. Strong applicants get invited to a short introductory call.



Only the people who follow all four steps will hear back.



---

title: Email Graphic Designer (Figma) - Part-Time to Full-Time
description:
Type: Part-time to start (~20 hrs/week), transitioning to full-time within 2–3 months

Hours: TBC (UK TIMEZONE) 

Pay: $700–$1,000/month part-time to start, scaling to $1,200–$1,800/month full-time based on experience and speed.

Start: ASAP



This is a firm, experience-required role. We are not training beginners on this one. If you don't have a real email design portfolio, please don't apply.



About Us



We're a small, boutique email marketing agency working with ecommerce and DTC brands. Right now the core team is just two of us, and we're building deliberately. Our long-term model is to run in pods (account manager, graphic designer, copywriter, and email builder per 5-10 clients) as we grow, but today it's lean: you, the founder, and a dedicated email builder handling the Klaviyo/Omnisend side.



That means this isn't a "slot into an existing machine" job. You'll have real input into how the design process works as we scale, and you'll be one of the first hires as we build toward the full pod structure.



The Role



We need a proper graphic designer, someone who lives in Figma and can design scroll-stopping, on-brand email templates for ecommerce clients. This is not a "drag and drop template" job. You'll be designing the actual visual layout, hierarchy, and style of campaign and flow emails from scratch, working from brand guidelines, past campaigns, and direct creative direction from the founder (until we bring on dedicated copywriters and account managers).



You will NOT be doing the Klaviyo/Omnisend build or scheduling, that's handled by our dedicated email builder. Your job is the design file. Clean, well-organized Figma work that a builder can pick up and slice without guesswork.



What You'll Be Doing



Designing email campaigns and flow templates in Figma (product launches, promos, custom email flow build outs etc.)

Maintaining brand consistency across multiple client accounts

Organizing Figma files cleanly (proper naming, layers, components) so builders can hand off quickly

Working from copy provided to make sure design supports the hierarchy (subject, header, CTA, body)

Adapting design systems for different brand aesthetics, this isn't one-size-fits-all

Occasionally designing supporting assets (banners, popups, social-to
 crossovers)





What We're Looking For





Strong portfolio of email design work (ecommerce/DTC experience is a must)

Confident, fast in Figma, including components, auto-layout, and organized file structure

Understanding of email design constraints (safe widths, mobile-first thinking, basic accessibility like contrast and font sizing) 

A good eye for hierarchy, typography, and brand adaptation, not just "pretty," but effective

Comfortable taking creative direction and revising based on feedback

Reliable communicator, comfortable with async updates and occasional live check-ins

Bonus: experience working in an agency or pod-style team setup





Why Join Us





Clear path from part-time to full-time within a few months as we onboard more clients

Ground-floor opportunity, you'll be one of our first three hires, with real potential to grow into a lead design role as we scale toward our pod model

Varied work across multiple ecommerce brands, not stuck designing for one repetitive style

Direct access to the founder, no layers of middle management, fast feedback, fast decisions





How to Apply



This role has a firm screening process. We're looking for someone experienced, so please expect the following steps, and don't apply if you're not willing to complete them:



Step 1: Application

Send the following:



Your updated resume

A link to your existing portfolio showing real email designs made in Figma (not mockups pulled from templates, not general graphic design work, actual emails you've designed)

A short note on your experience designing for ecommerce/DTC email campaigns

Your availability (hours/week) and your expected rate





Applications without a Figma portfolio link showing real email design work will not be considered.



Step 2: Short Quiz

Shortlisted applicants will be sent a short quiz covering email design fundamentals (layout, hierarchy, mobile-first thinking, brand adaptation). This isn't a trick test, it's there to confirm you actually know the craft, not just the software.



Step 3: Paid Test Task

Final candidates will be asked to design one sample email in Figma from a brief we provide, so we can see your actual process and output before hiring. [This test task will be paid a flat fee, to be confirmed.]



We know this is a more thorough process than a typical OnlineJobs.ph posting. That's intentional, we'd rather take a bit longer to find the right person than hire fast and hire wrong.
